question.zh: 边缘刚好碰上，算不算重叠？
question.en: Do touching edges count as overlap?

goals.zh: 分清越界、重叠与缺失三种失败。
goals.en: Distinguish overflow, overlap and missing blocks.

goals.zh: 用坐标解释接触合法、内部相交非法。
goals.en: Explain why contact is legal but interior overlap is not.

goals.zh: 亲手制造错误，再把布局修复。
goals.en: Create an error, then repair the layout.

intro.zh: 一块芯片的外框像一个尺寸已经定好的收纳盒。模块是必须完整放进去的矩形。把图画得漂亮不够：每块都必须出现一次、留在外框内，而且不能占用同一片内部空间。先建立这道检查关，后面的评分才有意义。
intro.en: Think of the chip outline as a box whose size is already fixed. Every rectangular block must appear exactly once, remain inside the box and avoid overlapping another block. A neat-looking drawing is not proof. Establish these checks before comparing quality.

sections.zh: 三个独立问题
sections.en: Three separate questions

sections.zh: 完整性检查名称集合：A—E 每个恰好一次。包含性检查每块的四条边：x≥0、y≥0、x+w≤10、y+h≤8。非重叠检查任意两块的内部。哪怕五块的面积和仍是 23，只要漏放或重叠，布局就不能通过。
sections.en: Completeness checks the IDs: A through E exactly once. Containment checks x≥0, y≥0, x+w≤10 and y+h≤8. Non-overlap checks every pair of interiors. An area sum of 23 does not prove that all blocks are present or separate.

sections.zh: 接触不是重叠
sections.en: Contact is not overlap

sections.zh: C 的右边界在 x=7，E 的左边界也在 x=7，两者只接触一条线，交叠面积为零。若把 E 移到 x=6，两个内部才共享宽 1、高 2 的区域。比较必须使用严格不等式，不能把贴边判成冲突。
sections.en: C ends at x=7 and E starts at x=7. They share a boundary line with zero area. Move E to x=6 and their interiors share a 1-by-2 region. The overlap test uses strict inequalities so touching edges remain legal.

sections.zh: 错误要能定位
sections.en: Make errors actionable

sections.zh: 只显示“非法”没有告诉你怎么修。检查器应指出“E 越过右边界”或“C 与 E 重叠”。本实验允许你把模块放错，错误对象会单独标记；修改后重新计算，不会偷偷替你摆回标准答案。
sections.en: An “illegal” badge alone does not explain the repair. Report “E crosses the right boundary” or “C overlaps E.” The lab lets you make mistakes, highlights the actual blocks and recomputes after every change.

pitfall.zh: 只数模块数量不够。A、A、C、D、E 也有五块，却重复 A、缺少 B。要比较名称集合和每个名称的出现次数。
pitfall.en: Counting blocks is insufficient. A,A,C,D,E still contains five entries but duplicates A and omits B. Check IDs and their multiplicity.

text.zh: E 位于 x=9，宽为 2，右边界在哪里？
text.en: E starts at x=9 and is 2 wide. Where is its right edge?

explain.zh: 9+2=11，超过外框右边界 10。
explain.en: 9+2=11, beyond the outline at 10.

text.zh: C 结束于 x=7，E 从 x=7 开始。
text.en: C ends at x=7; E starts at x=7.

explain.zh: 共边的面积为零；还需分别检查其余边界。
explain.en: A shared edge has zero area. The other boundaries still need checking.

text.zh: A、A、C、D、E 能通过完整性检查吗？
text.en: Does A,A,C,D,E pass completeness?

options.zh: 不能，缺 B 且 A 重复
options.en: No: B is missing and A repeats

explain.zh: 检查的是每个名称恰好一次，而不只是总数。
explain.en: Each required ID must occur exactly once.

text.zh: 检查器查了包含性和重叠。一个布局要通过，至少几项检查必须同时通过？
text.en: The checker tests containment and overlap. How many must pass together?

explain.zh: 任何一项失败都拒绝；合法性是门槛，不是分数。
explain.en: Either failure rejects the layout. Legality is a gate, not a score.

text.zh: 一个布局已经重叠，但密度仍算出 28.75%。这个数能当占用率报告吗？
text.en: An overlapping layout still computes 28.75% density. Is that a valid occupancy report?

explain.zh: 指标只有在包含性和非重叠都通过后才有意义。
explain.en: Metrics are meaningful only after containment and non-overlap both pass.

question.zh: 挪动模块后，为什么密度完全没变？
question.en: Why does moving blocks leave density unchanged?

goals.zh: 明确密度公式的分母。
goals.en: Name the denominator of each density.

goals.zh: 用包围盒区分两种合法摆法。
goals.en: Compare legal layouts using their bounding boxes.

goals.zh: 解释固定量与优化目标的区别。
goals.en: Separate invariants from optimization objectives.

intro.zh: 面积和是 23，固定外框面积是 80，所以外框死区是 57，外框密度是 28.75%。这些数不会因为挪动模块而改变。真正反映压紧程度的是围住模块的最小矩形。使用密度之前，先说清楚分母是哪一个面积。
intro.en: The blocks sum to 23 and the fixed outline has area 80. Outline deadspace is 57 and outline density is 28.75%. Moving the blocks changes none of these. Compactness instead depends on the smallest enclosing rectangle. Always name the denominator.

sections.zh: 先把账算清
sections.en: Get the accounting right

sections.zh: A=6、B=6、C=4、D=3、E=4，总和 23。外框 10×8=80。合法布局的外框死区是 80−23=57，密度为 23/80。非法布局仍能算出这个算式，但它不能作为有效布局的占用率报告。
sections.en: The block areas are 6,6,4,3,4, summing to 23. The 10×8 outline has area 80. A legal layout has outline deadspace 80−23=57 and density 23/80. The arithmetic can still run on an illegal layout, but it is not a valid occupancy report.

sections.zh: 包围盒会跟着布局变化
sections.en: The bounding box responds to placement

sections.zh: 标准摆法的包围盒是 9×3=27，内部空余 4，包围盒密度约 85.19%。另一种合法摆法可以达到 6×4=24，内部空余 1。两种布局的外框密度仍完全相同，不能据此判断哪个更紧凑。
sections.en: The reference layout has a 9×3 bounding box, area 27, with 4 empty units and about 85.19% packing density. A legal 6×4 layout has area 24 and 1 empty unit. Both retain the same outline density, so that metric cannot rank their compactness.

sections.zh: 紧凑只是一个目标
sections.en: Compactness is one objective

sections.zh: 真实设计还要为连线、电源、引脚、时序及布线通道留空间。本课不把较小的包围盒称为生产设计的“全面更优”。我们只在相同模块、相同外框和相同规则下比较面积，并把目标函数写出来。
sections.en: Real designs also need wiring, power, pins, timing and routing space. A smaller teaching bounding box is not a production sign-off. We compare area only under the same blocks, outline and rules, with an explicit objective.

modules.pseudo:
require legal(pack)
module_area = sum(w*h for each module)
outline_density = module_area / (W*H)
bbox = enclosing_rectangle(pack)
packing_density = module_area / bbox.area

pitfall.zh: 不要把空余量比例 γ=空余/模块面积，与外框空余比例=空余/外框面积混为一谈；“15% 空余”必须注明分母。
pitfall.en: A whitespace budget γ=empty/module area differs from the empty/outline fraction. “15% whitespace” needs a denominator.

text.zh: 把标准摆法压紧，外框仍为 10×8。外框密度？
text.en: Compact the same blocks inside 10×8. Outline density?

explain.zh: 23/80 不随模块位置变化。
explain.en: 23/80 does not depend on positions.

text.zh: 标准包围盒 9×3 的内部空余？
text.en: Empty area inside the reference 9×3 box?

explain.zh: 包围盒空余=27−23=4。57 是外框死区。
explain.en: 27−23=4. The value 57 belongs to outline deadspace.

text.zh: 把包围盒从 27 降到 24，哪项改变？
text.en: Reduce box area from 27 to 24. What changes?

explain.zh: 分母由 27 变为 24，模块面积和仍为 23。
explain.en: The denominator changes; total block area remains 23.

text.zh: 外框 10×8，模块面积和 23。外框死区是多少？
text.en: Outline 10×8, total block area 23. What is the outline deadspace?

explain.zh: 80−23=57；这是固定外框内部的空余。
explain.en: 80−23=57: unused area inside the fixed outline.

text.zh: 只把模块在框内挪动，不改变外框和模块面积。外框密度会怎样？
text.en: Move blocks inside the same outline; areas stay fixed. Outline density…

explain.zh: 分子与分母都不变；改变的是包围盒密度。
explain.en: Numerator and denominator are unchanged. Packing density may change.

title.zh: 九个符号，还原一张布局

question.zh: 一串字母和 H、V，怎么变回矩形？
question.en: How do letters, H and V become rectangles?

goals.zh: 按栈操作还原后缀表达式。
goals.en: Decode postfix with a stack.

goals.zh: 正确区分 H、V 与两个孩子的顺序。
goals.en: Keep H/V and operand order straight.

goals.zh: 区分表达式正确与几何可行。
goals.en: Separate syntax validity from geometric feasibility.

intro.zh: 切片表示把布局递归分成两个区域。叶子是模块，内部节点是贯穿当前区域的一刀。用后序遍历写成后缀表达式，就能用一个栈重新拼出区域。树结构给出相对关系，坐标由组合规则算出。
intro.en: A slicing representation recursively combines two regions. Leaves are blocks and internal nodes specify full cuts. Postorder produces a postfix expression that a stack can reconstruct. Structure describes relationships; combination rules compute the coordinates.

sections.zh: 先定 H/V 约定
sections.en: Fix the H/V convention

sections.zh: 本课 H 表示水平切线：第一个区域在下、第二个在上，宽取最大、高相加。V 表示垂直切线：第一个在左、第二个在右，宽相加、高取最大。字母命名的是切线，不是模块移动的方向。
sections.en: Here H names a horizontal cut: first region below second, maximum width and summed heights. V names a vertical cut: first left of second, summed widths and maximum height. The letter names the cut, not a movement direction.

sections.zh: 栈顶先弹出的是第二个孩子
sections.en: The first pop is the second child

sections.zh: 读 A 就压入 A，读 D 就压入 D。遇到 H，先弹出 D，再弹出 A，因此是 A 在下、D 在上，得到 3×3。继续读 B V C V E V，最后得到 9×3。把两个孩子弹出的顺序搞反，会得到另一张布局。
sections.en: Push A, then D. At H, pop D first and A second: A goes below D, yielding 3×3. Continue with B V C V E V to obtain 9×3. Reversing the popped operands changes the layout.

sections.zh: 不是所有布局都能切
sections.en: Not every arrangement is slicing

sections.zh: 表达式只剩一个栈元素，说明组合结构完成，不代表 A—E 都恰好出现一次，也不代表装得进外框。还要检查完整性和几何。某些风车形布局不存在避开全部模块内部的第一条贯穿切线，不能由切片树表达。
sections.en: A single stack item proves only that the combinations reduce to one region. Check block completeness and outline containment separately. Some pinwheel arrangements have no first through-cut avoiding all interiors, so slicing trees cannot represent them.

pitfall.zh: 语法合法的表达式也会越界。把标准表达式的第一个 H 改成 V，得到宽 12 的一行，超过宽 10 的外框。
pitfall.en: A syntactically valid expression can overflow. Change the reference’s first H to V and the row becomes 12 wide, exceeding the outline width of 10.

text.zh: A 为 3×2，D 为 3×1。A D H 的尺寸？
text.en: A is 3×2; D is 3×1. Size of A D H?

explain.zh: H：宽取 max(3,3)，高为 2+1。
explain.en: H takes max(3,3) for width and 2+1 for height.

text.zh: 先压 A、再压 D，遇到 H 先弹谁？
text.en: Push A then D. Who is popped first at H?

explain.zh: 后进先出；D 是第二个孩子。
explain.en: Last in, first out. D is the second child.

text.zh: 最后栈中只剩一个元素，能保证装进外框吗？
text.en: Does one final stack item guarantee outline fit?

explain.zh: 结构和几何是两道独立检查。
explain.en: Structure and geometry are separate checks.

text.zh: 表达式最后只剩一个栈元素，能保证每个模块恰好出现一次吗？
text.en: One final stack item remains. Does that prove each block appears exactly once?

explain.zh: 栈归约成功只说明组合结构完成；重复和缺失要单独查。
explain.en: Reduction to one region proves structure, not uniqueness or completeness.

text.zh: 是否存在一些布局，完全没有可用的贯穿第一刀？
text.en: Can some layouts have no valid first through-cut?

options.en: Yes, a pinwheel is one example

explain.zh: 没有贯穿第一刀，就不能写成切片树；这正是切片表示的局限。
explain.en: Without a first through-cut, the layout is non-slicing. That is the limit of slicing trees.

title.zh: 树给横坐标，轮廓线给高度
title.en: The tree gives x. The skyline gives y.

question.zh: 右孩子一定直接坐在父节点上吗？
question.en: Does a right child sit directly on its parent?

goals.zh: 按先序遍历正确摆放模块。
goals.en: Pack blocks in preorder.

goals.zh: 用覆盖宽度上的最高轮廓线计算 y。
goals.en: Compute y from the highest skyline under a block.

goals.zh: 用反例解释“右孩子=父块正上方”的局限。
goals.en: Disprove “right child always rests on its parent.”

intro.zh: B*-tree 把每块模块放进二叉树。左孩子从父模块右边缘开始，右孩子与父模块左边缘对齐。但高度不是从父模块直接抄来：模块会落到自身整个宽度下方的最高轮廓线上。这个细节决定了算法是否正确。
intro.en: A B*-tree places each block in a binary tree. A left child starts at its parent’s right edge; a right child shares its parent’s left edge. Height is not copied from the parent: the block rests on the highest skyline anywhere under its full width.

sections.zh: 遍历顺序是算法的一部分
sections.en: Traversal order is part of the algorithm

sections.zh: 先放当前节点，再处理整个左子树，最后处理右子树。标准树 A(B(C(E,-),-),D) 的顺序是 A、B、C、E、D。若在左子树完成前先放右孩子，已有轮廓线不同，结果也可能不同。
sections.en: Place a node, then its entire left subtree, then its right subtree. The reference A(B(C(E,-),-),D) visits A,B,C,E,D. Moving a right child ahead of the left subtree changes the skyline it sees.

sections.zh: 交换 A 与 C，看 D 被谁托住
sections.en: Swap A and C: who supports D?

sections.zh: 标准树里 D 在 (0,2)，恰好坐在 A 上。交换 A 与 C 的名称后，D 的左边缘仍为 x=0，但它宽 3，跨过了高度为 3 的 B。于是 D 落在 y=3，而不是根模块 C 顶部的 y=2。轮廓线必须检查整个区间。
sections.en: In the reference, D is at (0,2), directly on A. Swap the names A and C. D still starts at x=0, but its width of 3 reaches across B, which is 3 high. D lands at y=3, not at C’s top of 2. Inspect the full footprint.

sections.zh: 可复现的反例比背规则有用
sections.en: A counterexample beats memorization

sections.zh: 本课固定尺寸、禁止旋转时，一共有 Catalan(5)×5!=5040 棵有标号二叉树。穷举得到 4680 棵装得下，所有解均无内部重叠，最小包围盒面积为 24。这些结论只对本课五块数据和规则成立，不是任意芯片的最优性保证。
sections.en: With fixed sizes and no rotation there are Catalan(5)×5!=5040 labelled binary trees. Enumeration finds 4680 that fit, no interior overlaps, and minimum box area 24. These are results for this five-block instance and these rules, not a general optimization guarantee.

modules.pseudo:
walk(node,x):
  y = maximum_skyline(x, x+node.width)
  place(node,x,y)
  raise_skyline(x,x+node.width,y+node.height)
  walk(node.left, x+node.width)
  walk(node.right,x)

pitfall.zh: 只跑标准树抓不出“直接抄父模块高度”的错误：标准树恰好能算对。必须再跑 lift 等反例。
pitfall.en: The reference alone cannot expose a parent-height shortcut: that example happens to work. Include counterexamples such as lift.

text.zh: 交换 A、C 后，D 的 y 坐标？
text.en: After swapping A and C, what is D’s y?

explain.zh: D 的宽度跨到 B 上；B 的顶部是 3。
explain.en: D’s footprint reaches B, whose top is 3.

text.zh: 标准树的遍历顺序？
text.en: Walk order of the reference tree?

explain.zh: 整个左子树要在右孩子 D 之前完成。
explain.en: Finish the entire left subtree before D.

text.zh: B*-tree 不重叠，是否一定装进 10×8？
text.en: A B*-tree is non-overlapping. Must it fit 10×8?

explain.zh: 轮廓线避免内部重叠，但不保证外框约束。
explain.en: Skyline packing avoids overlap but does not enforce outline fit.

text.zh: 左孩子的 y 坐标一定和父节点相同吗？
text.en: Must a left child have the same y as its parent?

options.zh: 不一定，y 由轮廓线决定
options.en: No; y comes from the skyline

explain.zh: 左孩子只继承 x；高度要看它整个宽度下方的最高轮廓线。
explain.en: A left child inherits x only. Its y is the highest skyline under its full width.

text.zh: 五块总面积 23。5040 棵有标号二叉树中，最小包围盒面积是多少？
text.en: Total block area is 23. Across 5040 labelled trees, what is the smallest box area?

explain.zh: 23 只能排成 1×23，B 高 3 放不下；最小是 6×4=24。
explain.en: Area 23 would require a 1×23 strip, too thin for B. The minimum is 6×4=24.

title.zh: 两行字母，决定上下左右

question.zh: 关系已经给定，坐标为什么要取最大值？
question.en: Why do coordinates use a maximum?

goals.zh: 从两个排列读出每一对模块的方向。
goals.en: Read each pair’s direction from two permutations.

goals.zh: 用最长路径计算最小可行坐标。
goals.en: Compute compact coordinates with longest paths.

goals.zh: 解释不重叠与装得下的区别。
goals.en: Distinguish non-overlap from outline fit.

intro.zh: 序列对使用两个模块排列记录相对关系。两个排列中先后顺序相同，较早的模块在左；顺序相反，则在本课约定中较早的模块在下。把所有关系写成坐标不等式，再按拓扑顺序做最长路径计算。
intro.en: A sequence pair uses two permutations. If a pair has the same order in both, the earlier block goes left. If the order is reversed, the earlier block in pos goes below under this course’s convention. Turn relationships into inequalities and solve longest paths.

sections.zh: 先写清方向约定
sections.en: State the vertical convention

sections.zh: 若 i 在 pos、neg 中都先于 j，建立水平边 i→j，要求 xj≥xi+wi。若 i 在 pos 中先、neg 中后，建立竖直边 i→j，要求 yj≥yi+hi。有些资料的竖直约定相反，不能只抄箭头，必须同时检查坐标和不等式。
sections.en: If i precedes j in both orders, add horizontal edge i→j with xj≥xi+wi. If i precedes j in pos but follows it in neg, add vertical edge i→j with yj≥yi+hi. Other texts may reverse the vertical convention; keep inequalities and coordinates consistent.

sections.zh: 满足所有前驱，所以取最大
sections.en: Take the maximum to satisfy every predecessor

sections.zh: 一个模块可能有多个左侧前驱。只满足其中一个会与另一个相撞。因此 xj=max(xi+wi)，对所有水平前驱取最大；y 同理。边的权重使用前驱尺寸，因为要跨过的是前驱占用的空间。pos 本身就是两张图的拓扑序。
sections.en: A block can have several predecessors. Satisfying just one may collide with another. Thus xj=max(xi+wi) over horizontal predecessors, and similarly for y. Use the predecessor’s dimension because its occupied space must be cleared. pos is a topological order for both graphs.

sections.zh: 同一数据，不同表示
sections.en: Same data, different representation

sections.zh: 标准序列 ABCED / DABCE 得到 D(0,3)，包围盒 9×4=36；标准 B*-tree 则得到 D(0,2)，包围盒 27。这里比较的是两份指定编码，不代表序列对算法一定比 B*-tree 差。要看表示能力得穷举编码空间：本课五块固定尺寸、禁旋转时，B*-tree 的 5040 棵树与序列对的 14400 个编码都能表达面积 24 的布局；切片表示做不到——26880 份切片编码穷举下来最小只到 25，一份 24 都没有。注意两句证据要分开：上一课那张 24 布局没有任何一条贯穿的第一刀，所以它自己写不成切片树，但这只否定了那一张布局；“所有切片编码都到不了 24”是靠上面这次完备穷举得出的，不能由一个反例推出来，也不适用于别的规模或别的工程模型。
sections.en: The reference ABCED / DABCE gives D(0,3) and box 9×4=36, while the reference B*-tree gives D(0,2) and area 27. These are two chosen encodings, not evidence that one representation is worse. Capability has to be judged by enumerating the encoding space: for these five fixed blocks and no rotation, the 5040 B*-tree packings and all 14400 sequence pairs contain an area-24 layout, while all 26880 slicing encodings bottom out at 25 with none at 24. Keep the two pieces of evidence apart: the 24 layout from the previous lesson has no through first cut, so that single layout cannot be written as a slicing tree; the claim that no slicing encoding reaches 24 rests on the complete enumeration above, not on one counterexample, and it does not extend to other sizes or other floorplanning models.

pitfall.zh: 两个完整排列保证相对关系一致，解码不重叠；它们没有替你检查固定外框。全部按同一顺序排列会排成宽 12 的一行。
pitfall.en: Two complete permutations produce consistent, non-overlapping constraints. They do not check the fixed outline. Identical orders produce a row 12 wide.

text.zh: i 在两个排列中都先于 j。i 在 j 的哪边？
text.en: i precedes j in both permutations. i is…

explain.zh: 相同顺序对应水平约束。
explain.en: The same order yields a horizontal constraint.

text.zh: xj 的两个下界为 3 和 5，最小可行 xj？
text.en: Two lower bounds for xj are 3 and 5. Minimum feasible xj?

explain.zh: 要同时满足两个下界，所以取 max=5。
explain.en: Both bounds must hold; take max=5.

text.zh: 标准序列对里的 D 位于哪里？
text.en: Where is D in the reference sequence pair?

explain.zh: A、B、C、E 都在 D 下方，其中 B 高 3。
explain.en: A,B,C,E precede D vertically; B reaches height 3.

text.zh: 一个模块有多个左侧前驱，xj 应取哪个值？
text.en: A block has several left predecessors. Which xj do you take?

explain.zh: 要同时满足全部前驱，所以取所有 xi+wi 的最大值。
explain.en: Every predecessor must be cleared, so take the maximum xi+wi.

text.zh: 两个完整排列保证解码不重叠，是否也保证装进 10×8？
text.en: Two complete permutations decode without overlap. Do they also guarantee fitting 10×8?

explain.zh: 序列对只保证相对关系一致；外框包含性仍需单独检查。
explain.en: The pair only fixes relative order; containment is still a separate check.

title.zh: 偶尔后退，能否走得更远？
title.en: Can a worse move help the search?

question.zh: 为什么接受一个暂时更差的布局？
question.en: Why accept a temporarily worse layout?

goals.zh: 分清当前解、候选解与历史最好解。
goals.en: Separate current, candidate and best-so-far.

goals.zh: 用 ΔE、温度和随机数解释接受判定。
goals.en: Explain acceptance using ΔE, temperature and a random draw.

goals.zh: 在相同预算与种子下复现实验。
goals.en: Reproduce a run with a stated seed and budget.

intro.zh: 表示法告诉我们怎样写下一个布局，搜索告诉我们怎样在许多编码之间选择。这里在序列对的某一个排列里交换两个名称作为邻居，用包围盒面积和越界惩罚评分。每一步既可能接受，也可能拒绝，但历史最好合法解始终单独保存。
intro.en: A representation encodes a layout; search chooses among encodings. Here a neighbor swaps two names in one permutation. Energy is bounding-box area plus an overflow penalty. Each proposal may be accepted or rejected, while the best legal solution is stored separately.

sections.zh: 先把能量写明
sections.en: Make the energy explicit

sections.zh: 本实验 E=包围盒面积+100×(宽度超出量+高度超出量)。这是便于教学的面积与越界模型，没有包含线长、时序或布线拥塞。序列对解码保证不重叠；越界候选可以探索，但不能被记录为最好合法解。
sections.en: The teaching energy is box area +100×(width overflow+height overflow). It excludes wirelength, timing and congestion. Sequence-pair decoding prevents overlap. Overflowing candidates can be explored but cannot become the best legal solution.

sections.zh: 接受概率不是成功概率
sections.en: Acceptance probability is not success probability

sections.zh: 令 ΔE=候选能量−当前能量。若 ΔE≤0，接受；否则用 p=exp(−ΔE/T)，抽 u∈[0,1)，当 u
sections.en: Let ΔE=candidate−current energy. Accept non-increasing moves. Otherwise use p=exp(−ΔE/T), draw u in [0,1), and accept when u<p. Higher temperature tolerates the same uphill move more often. Cooling makes the search more selective; it does not guarantee an optimum.

sections.zh: 复现一次搜索
sections.en: Reproduce a search

sections.zh: 固定输入、邻居操作、随机数生成器、种子、温度、冷却率和步数，才能复现整条轨迹。只展示一次漂亮结果不能证明算法稳定。比较不同参数时要使用相同预算，并区分单次运行与多次运行统计。
sections.en: Reproduction needs the input, neighbor rule, RNG, seed, temperature, cooling rate and step count. One attractive run does not establish reliability. Compare settings under the same budget and distinguish individual runs from repeated-run statistics.

modules.pseudo:
current = decode(initial_pair); best_legal = None
repeat for a fixed budget:
  candidate = decode(random_swap(current_pair))
  delta = E(candidate)-E(current)
  accept if delta<=0 or random()<exp(-delta/T)
  update best_legal if current is legal and better
  T = T*cooling

pitfall.zh: 当前解可能变差，所以不要把“当前能量”当作“历史最好能量”。历史最好合法解的面积只会持平或下降。
pitfall.en: The current solution may get worse. Do not label current energy as best-so-far. The best legal area never increases.

text.zh: ΔE=4，T 从 1 增到 10，接受概率怎样变化？
text.en: ΔE=4. Raise T from 1 to 10. Acceptance probability…

explain.zh: exp(−4/10) 大于 exp(−4)。
explain.en: exp(−4/10) exceeds exp(−4).

text.zh: 接受了一个更差候选，历史最好解要被覆盖吗？
text.en: Accept a worse candidate. Overwrite the best-so-far?

explain.zh: 接受更新当前解；历史最好解只在合法且更好时更新。
explain.en: Acceptance updates current; the incumbent changes only for a better legal layout.

text.zh: 固定种子能保证全局最优吗？
text.en: Does a fixed seed guarantee global optimality?

explain.zh: 种子控制随机轨迹，不改变启发式的保证。
explain.en: The seed controls the random trajectory, not an optimality guarantee.

text.zh: ΔE 为正且不变，把温度调低，接受这个变差候选的概率会怎样？
text.en: ΔE stays positive. Lower the temperature. The chance of accepting the worse candidate…

explain.zh: p=exp(−ΔE/T)，T 变小，指数更负，接受概率下降。
explain.en: p=exp(−ΔE/T); a smaller T makes the exponent more negative, so p falls.

text.zh: 历史最好合法解在什么时候更新？
text.en: When is the best legal solution updated?

options.zh: 当前解合法且比它更好时
options.en: When the current solution is legal and better
When the current solution gets worse

explain.zh: 接受只改变当前解；历史最好只在合法且更优时替换。
explain.en: Acceptance changes the current solution. The incumbent changes only for a better legal layout.

title.zh: 软模块：从形状约束到逐步重摆
title.en: Soft blocks: from shape constraints to stepwise repacking

question.zh: A 变窄了，为什么布局反而非法？
question.en: A becomes narrower. Why does the layout become illegal?

goals.zh: 独立筛选满足面积和宽高比的形状。
goals.en: Filter shapes by area and aspect-ratio constraints.

goals.zh: 用坐标计算一次正面积重叠。
goals.en: Calculate positive-area overlap from coordinates.

goals.zh: 解释每次重摆及合法性与优化的区别。
goals.en: Explain each move and distinguish legality from improvement.

goals.zh: 正确选择密度分母，并迁移到新的面积。
goals.en: Choose the correct density denominator and transfer to a new area.

intro.zh: 硬模块的长宽由实现决定；软模块在教学模型中面积固定、形状可调。A 的面积为 6，宽高比 w/h 限制在 0.5 到 2。变窄会同时变高，所以改变 A 后必须重新检查邻居。形状优化的完整动作是“选形状—重摆—评判”。
intro.en: Hard blocks have fixed dimensions. In this teaching model a soft block keeps its area but can change shape. A has area 6 and aspect ratio w/h between 0.5 and 2. Making it narrower also makes it taller, so recheck its neighbors. The full loop is reshape, repack, evaluate.

sections.zh: 1. 先确定哪些量可以改变
sections.en: 1. Establish what may change

sections.zh: 软模块是早期规划中的一种抽象：面积给定，宽和高可以在指定范围内调整。它不是“任何电路都可以任意拉伸”的承诺。硬模块的尺寸来自已有实现，不能为了让示意图更整齐而随意改动。本例中只有 A 可以变形；B、C、D、E 的尺寸固定，所有模块都不能仅因动画需要而增减面积。形状由宽 w、高 h 描述，位置由左下角坐标 (x,y) 描述。修改形状和修改位置是两类操作，必须分别记录。即使 A 的某个新形状通过检查，把它放回原位置也可能与邻居冲突。因此，检查一个矩形本身的形状，不能代替检查整个布局。
sections.en: A soft block is an early-planning abstraction: its area is specified while its dimensions can vary within stated limits. This does not mean that every finished circuit can be stretched freely. A hard block has dimensions determined by an existing implementation. In this example, only A may reshape. B, C, D, and E keep their given dimensions. No block may gain or lose area simply to make the picture look better. Describe a shape using width w and height h, and describe its position using lower-left coordinates (x,y). These are separate decisions. A shape checker can examine A without reading any neighbor coordinates. A placement checker must examine the complete set of rectangles. Consequently, an allowed new shape can still produce an illegal placement at the old coordinates. Always record which dimensions changed and which coordinates changed before interpreting the result.

sections.zh: 2. 面积与宽高比必须同时满足
sections.en: 2. Enforce area and aspect ratio together

sections.zh: A 的约束是 w>0、h>0、wh=6、0.5≤w/h≤2。宽高比始终定义为宽除以高，不在不同页面交换分子、分母。原形状 3×2 的面积为6、比例为1.5；新形状 2×3 的面积也为6、比例约0.667，两者都允许。1×6 虽然面积正确，但比例约0.167；6×1 的比例为6，二者都被比例约束排除。不要用面积正确来推断形状正确，也不要把“形状正确”写成“布局合法”。在程序中，先处理非正尺寸，避免在 h=0 时计算比例；再检查面积误差，最后检查包含端点的比例范围。显示为0.67只是舍入，内部计算仍应保留真实值。
sections.en: A must satisfy w>0, h>0, wh=6, and 0.5≤w/h≤2. Keep the definition of aspect ratio consistent: width divided by height. The original 3×2 shape has area 6 and ratio 1.5. The alternative 2×3 shape also has area 6 and ratio about 0.667. Both satisfy the shape contract. However, 1×6 has ratio about 0.167, and 6×1 has ratio 6. Correct area does not rescue either extreme. Implement the checks in a deliberate order. Reject nonpositive dimensions before division, then check area with an explicit numerical tolerance, and finally check the inclusive ratio bounds. Use full numerical precision internally. A displayed ratio such as 0.67 is a rounded label, not a replacement for the actual ratio. Passing these shape checks says nothing about overlap, completeness, or outline containment.

sections.zh: 3. 整数模型与连续模型不要混用
sections.en: 3. Separate integer and continuous models

sections.zh: 整数实验要求宽、高都是正整数。先枚举面积6的因数对，再用比例条件筛选，才能得出只剩2×3和3×2。连续模型允许非整数尺寸，候选远不止两个。若选择宽度w，可令h=6/w；代入比例条件得到0.5≤w²/6≤2，所以√3≤w≤√12。动画从3×2变到2×3时，采用宽度过渡后由面积恢复高度的方式，避免中间帧面积漂移。这里的中间尺寸用于说明连续变形，不新增整数实验选项。不要分别线性变化宽和高，也不要分别取整，再声称面积恒定。若实际实现必须落到离散网格，应重新检查取整后的形状是否可行。
sections.en: The integer experiment requires both dimensions to be positive integers. Enumerate the factor pairs of 6 and then apply the ratio bounds; only 2×3 and 3×2 remain. A continuous model permits noninteger dimensions and therefore has many more candidates. If width is selected first, use h=6/w. Substitution gives 0.5≤w²/6≤2, or √3≤w≤√12. These continuous bounds explain why width cannot approach zero or grow without limit. The animation varies width and calculates height from the fixed area, so intermediate frames also preserve area. Those intermediate dimensions illustrate a continuous transition; they are not extra buttons in the integer lab. Independently interpolating or rounding both dimensions generally changes the product. If a physical or software implementation requires discrete dimensions, apply its discretization rule and run the complete shape check again rather than assuming feasibility survives rounding.

sections.zh: 4. 用坐标读出占用区间
sections.en: 4. Read occupied intervals from coordinates

sections.zh: 左下角是原点，x向右增加，y向上增加。一个(x,y,w,h)矩形占横向区间[x,x+w]、纵向区间[y,y+h]。原始A=(0,0,3,2)，D=(0,2,3,1)，因此A的顶部和D的底部都在y=2。两者共享边界，却没有共享内部面积。其余模块为B=(3,0,2,3)、C=(5,0,2,2)、E=(7,0,2,2)。最右边缘9、最高边缘3，最小坐标都为0，所以包围盒为9×3=27。一般公式必须使用最大右边缘减最小x、最大上边缘减最小y；不能只乘两个最大边界，否则整体平移会错误改变包围盒面积。
sections.en: Coordinates use a lower-left origin, with x increasing rightward and y upward. A rectangle (x,y,w,h) occupies horizontal interval [x,x+w] and vertical interval [y,y+h]. Initially A=(0,0,3,2) and D=(0,2,3,1). A’s top and D’s bottom both lie at y=2, so they share a boundary without sharing interior area. The other blocks are B=(3,0,2,3), C=(5,0,2,2), and E=(7,0,2,2). The rightmost edge is 9 and the highest edge is 3. Because both minimum coordinates are zero here, the baseline bounding box is 9×3=27. In the general formula, subtract minimum x from maximum right edge and minimum y from maximum top edge. Multiplying only the maximum edges incorrectly makes bounding-box area depend on translation. Coordinate intervals also provide a direct way to justify contact and overlap.

sections.zh: 5. 把碰撞面积算出来
sections.en: 5. Calculate the collision area

sections.zh: A变成(0,0,2,3)后，与D的横向公共区间是0到2，纵向公共区间是2到3，重叠面积为2×1=2。两个方向都必须有正长度，才是正面积重叠。通用重叠宽度为max(0,min(x1+w1,x2+w2)−max(x1,x2))，高度同理；二者相乘得到面积。若某一方向的公共长度为0，则只是贴边或角点接触。本次失败不是A面积增加，而是面积固定时它新增了上方占用区域。检查器应指出A/D，而不是给一个不解释原因的红色失败标志。把“变窄所以更安全”的直觉改为逐方向检查，才能在新的布局上继续使用。
sections.en: After A becomes (0,0,2,3), its shared horizontal interval with D runs from 0 to 2. Their shared vertical interval runs from 2 to 3. The overlap area is therefore 2×1=2. Both shared lengths must be positive for an interior overlap. In general, overlap width is max(0,min(x1+w1,x2+w2)−max(x1,x2)); compute height the same way and multiply them. If either length is zero, the rectangles only touch along an edge or at a corner. A’s total area did not increase. Its occupied region moved upward as its width decreased, which is exactly why the old neighbor became a conflict. A useful checker identifies A and D and gives the reason. Replace the vague intuition that narrower means safer with explicit horizontal and vertical interval checks; the same method then transfers to other dimensions and coordinates.

sections.zh: 6. 局部修复也可能制造新冲突
sections.en: 6. A local repair can create another conflict

sections.zh: 把D从(0,2)移到(2,2)，虽然消除了A/D冲突，却与B在x=3…5、y=2…3重叠。只检查原来的那一对模块不够，每次改动后都要检查完整布局。再把D移到(2,3)，它的底部与B顶部贴合，恢复合法。但这时包围盒是9×4=36，比原来的27更大。这不是检查器出错，而是两个目标本来就不同：修复的任务是恢复可行性，优化的任务是在可行解之间比较明确的目标。动画里的位置过渡用于说明端点变化，并不保证搬运路径上的每个中间帧都无重叠；变化中不提前颁发合法判定。
sections.en: Moving D from (0,2) to (2,2) removes the A/D collision but creates a B/D collision. The new shared region spans x=3…5 and y=2…3. Checking only the original conflicting pair would miss this new failure. Recheck the complete placement after each edit. Moving D again to (2,3) puts its bottom against B’s top and restores legality. Yet the box becomes 9×4=36, which is larger than the baseline 27. The checker is not contradicting itself. Repair asks whether a placement satisfies the constraints; optimization compares a stated objective among feasible placements. Both questions matter. The animated motion illustrates a change between endpoint placements, not a proof that a physical transport path remains collision-free. During motion, the interface withholds a final legality result and evaluates the settled endpoint. Use the final coordinates to explain the judgment.

sections.zh: 7. 为什么要逐块重新摆放
sections.en: 7. Explain each repacking decision

sections.zh: 从合法但松散的布局开始，先把B左移到(2,0)，贴住A；再把C左移到(4,0)，贴住B。最后把D放到(4,2)，让它位于C上方、B右边、E左侧。检查D与三个邻居的区间，确认只有边界接触。新布局为9×3=27，说明一次合法重摆也可能只是回到原有面积。继续优化时，观察是谁决定包围盒的最右边界：E在(7,0)，宽2，所以右边缘为9。要真正缩小宽度，必须为E找到更靠内的位置。这里不是让学生背一组神奇坐标，而是识别限制边界，再安排邻居腾出空间。
sections.en: Starting from the legal but loose placement, move B to (2,0), touching A. Move C to (4,0), touching B. Then place D at (4,2), above C, right of B, and left of E. Check D against all three neighbors and confirm that the contacts have zero overlap area. This placement returns to 9×3=27. It is legal, but reshaping and repacking have not yet beaten the baseline. To improve further, identify which block determines the limiting boundary. E starts at (7,0) and has width 2, so its right edge fixes the current width at 9. Reducing the box width requires finding a destination for E farther inward. This reasoning is more useful than memorizing a set of special coordinates: inspect the boundary, identify the responsible block, and arrange its neighbors to make a feasible destination.

sections.zh: 8. 压紧到24需要怎样的空间交换
sections.en: 8. Make room before moving E inward

sections.zh: 先把D放到(0,3)，腾出C上方的2×2区域。这时最右边仍有E，包围盒暂时为36；中间状态不是最终优化结果。再把E从(7,0)移到(4,2)。它贴在C上方、B右侧，与D没有内部交叠。现在最大右边缘为6、最大上边缘为4，得到6×4=24。模块面积和为23，所以合法包围盒内只剩1单位空余，位于x=3…4、y=3…4。应说“这是一份面积24的合法见证”。本课没有证明连续软模块模型的全局最优，也没有把它推广到不同面积、连线或约束的实例。
sections.en: Move D to (0,3) first. This frees a 2×2 destination above C. E still extends to the right, so the intermediate box temporarily has area 36. An intermediate edit is not the final optimization result. Next move E from (7,0) to (4,2). It touches C’s top and B’s right edge without sharing interior space with D. The maximum right edge is now 6 and the maximum top edge is 4, giving 6×4=24. Total block area remains 23, so this legal box contains one empty unit, located at x=3…4 and y=3…4. Call this a verified legal witness with area 24. The lesson does not prove a global optimum over all continuous soft shapes, and this witness does not establish results for different blocks, connections, or placement constraints.

sections.zh: 9. 报告指标时，写清楚分母
sections.en: 9. State the denominator when reporting density

sections.zh: 固定外框面积为80，模块面积和为23，故固定外框密度为23/80=28.75%。对所有面积和不变、使用同一外框的合法摆法，该比例相同；它不能证明压紧操作有效。包围盒密度则用当前包围盒面积作分母，从23/27≈85.19%提高到23/24≈95.83%。两个比例回答不同的问题。非法布局中仍能写23/80，却不能把它当成通过约束的有效得分；模块面积相加也不等于被占区域的并集面积。只有先确认无重叠，才能用包围盒面积减23解释盒内空余。外框死区57与盒内空余1也不能混称为同一个量。
sections.en: The outline has area 80 and the blocks have total area 23, giving fixed-outline density 23/80=28.75%. This ratio is identical for legal placements with the same total area and outline. It cannot demonstrate that compaction succeeded. Packing density instead divides by the current bounding-box area, changing from 23/27≈85.19% to 23/24≈95.83%. The two ratios answer different questions. An illegal placement still permits the arithmetic expression 23/80, but that expression is not a certificate that constraints passed. Also, adding block areas does not equal occupied union area when blocks overlap. Confirm non-overlap before interpreting box area minus 23 as empty area. The fixed outline has 57 unoccupied units in any legal placement here, while the compact bounding box has only 1. Name the reference rectangle each time so that different kinds of empty area are not silently conflated.

sections.zh: 10. 在新例子上验证自己真的会了
sections.en: 10. Transfer the checks to another example

sections.zh: 把单个模块面积改为8，比例范围仍含端点0.5与2。正整数因数对为1×8、2×4、4×2、8×1；筛选后留下2×4与4×2。它们刚好处在两个比例边界，代码不能把≤误写成<。3×3虽然形状看着规整，却因面积为9而失败。回到公共五模块实验，先独立把A设为2×3并修复全部冲突，再尝试包围盒不超过24。记录形状、所有坐标、合法性与面积，解释关键移动；不要只提交一张绿色截图。查看答案、装入演示与独立完成分别记录。真实设计还需要线长、拥塞等目标，本课的几何优化结论不能替代这些检查。
sections.en: For a separate block of area 8 with inclusive ratio bounds 0.5 and 2, enumerate 1×8, 2×4, 4×2, and 8×1. Filtering leaves 2×4 and 4×2. Their ratios are exactly the allowed endpoints, so code must not replace inclusive comparisons with strict ones. A visually tidy 3×3 shape fails because its area is 9. Return to the shared five-block lab and independently keep A at 2×3 while repairing every conflict. Then attempt a legal box of area at most 24. Record the shape, all coordinates, legality, and box area, and explain the key moves rather than submitting only a green screenshot. Viewing an answer, loading a demonstration, and solving independently are different outcomes. Finally, remember that real designs also involve wirelength, routing congestion, and other objectives. Geometric compactness in this small instance does not replace those additional checks.

sections.zh: 11. Python检查应怎样拆开
sections.en: 11. Separate the Python checks

sections.zh: 本课Python函数valid_shape只检查一个矩形的形状，不负责读取五块坐标或判定邻居。对w=0或h=0应直接返回False，不能先除以h。用明确的小误差容限检查面积乘积，再检查宽高比的上下界。用2×3、3×2作为正常例子，用2×2、1×6、零宽作为反例，并加入面积8的2×4、4×2边界例子。不要只测试返回True的情况。形状函数通过后，再把新尺寸交给完整布局检查器，检查名称、框内包含与全部模块对。浏览器的停止和超时只限制运行时间，不证明你的算法正确；所有测试通过也只证明这些用例通过，需要能解释每条条件。
sections.en: The Python function valid_shape checks one rectangle, not the positions of all five blocks. For zero width or height, return False before performing division. Use an explicit small tolerance for the area product, then test the lower and upper ratio bounds. Include ordinary positive examples such as 2×3 and 3×2, but also wrong-area examples, an excessively tall shape, and zero width. Add the area-8 endpoint cases 2×4 and 4×2. A suite containing only successful shapes cannot reveal a function that always returns True. After the shape function passes, submit its dimensions to the separate placement checker, which examines names, containment, and every pair of modules. The browser’s stop button and time limit control execution; they do not establish correctness. Passing the available tests supports those cases, and you should still explain why each condition is required.

sections.zh: 12. 独立练习的提交证据
sections.en: 12. Evidence for an independent solution

sections.zh: 做实验时保留自己的输入与每次关键改变。先完成形状筛选，再制造一次碰撞并用区间解释它，最后修复并比较包围盒。扩展挑战要求A保持2×3、完整布局合法且包围盒不超过24，可以用不同于讲解的操作顺序；不要求模仿动画中的搬动轨迹。若看过提示或答案，应如实标记，不把“已显示答案”记成独立求解。解释应包括一个失败原因、一次修复的依据，以及实际改善的指标。看到28.75%不变时，要能指出它使用固定外框80作分母。这些证据比只给出最终截图更能证明你掌握了方法。
sections.en: Keep your own inputs and the important edits while working through the lab. First filter shapes, then create and explain one collision using intervals, and finally repair it and compare the box. The extended challenge keeps A at 2×3, requires a complete legal placement, and targets box area at most 24. Different edit sequences are acceptable; you do not need to imitate the animation’s movement path. If you use a hint or reveal an answer, record that honestly rather than treating the displayed solution as an independent result. Your explanation should identify one actual failure, justify one repair, and name the metric that improved. When 28.75% remains unchanged, explain that its denominator is the fixed outline area 80. These observations, together with the final coordinates and checker result, provide stronger evidence of understanding than a final screenshot alone.

sections.zh: 13. 整数网格下，为什么24已经最优
sections.en: 13. Why 24 is optimal on the integer grid

sections.zh: 先明确模型：宽、高取正整数，左下角坐标也是整数，轴对齐、禁止旋转，A—E完整放入10×8外框且内部不重叠，A满足面积6和宽高比0.5到2。包围盒的宽是最大右边缘减最小x，高是最大上边缘减最小y，因此两者都是正整数。无重叠时，包围盒面积至少是模块面积和23。若面积恰为23，由于23是质数，整数边长只能是1×23或23×1；任一种都容不下固定2×2的C。因此面积23不可行，整数面积至少24。合法见证A=(0,0,2,3)、B=(2,0,2,3)、C=(4,0,2,2)、D=(0,3,3,1)、E=(4,2,2,2)达到6×4=24，下界与见证相等，才证明此整数模型的最优值是24。底层几何检查函数能处理小数；上述质数分解排除法不直接证明连续模型最优。A维持原来的3×2也存在面积24的合法布局，例如A=(0,0,3,2)、B=(4,1,2,3)、C=(0,2,2,2)、D=(3,0,3,1)、E=(2,2,2,2)。所以本例不证明软变形优于固定形状最优，也不证明所有改进路径都必须先变差。
sections.en: Fix the model first: positive integer dimensions, integer lower-left coordinates, axis alignment, no rotation, all five blocks inside the ten-by-eight outline without interior overlap, and A with area six and ratio between one half and two. Bounding-box width is the maximum right edge minus minimum x; height is defined analogously, so both are positive integers. Non-overlap gives an area lower bound of twenty-three. Since twenty-three is prime, a box of that exact area with integer sides can only be one by twenty-three or twenty-three by one. Neither contains the fixed two-by-two C. Thus integer box area is at least twenty-four. The legal witness A=(0,0,2,3), B=(2,0,2,3), C=(4,0,2,2), D=(0,3,3,1), E=(4,2,2,2) has box six by four, attaining that bound. This proves optimality only for the stated integer model; the checker also accepts decimal inputs, where this factorization argument is insufficient. Keeping A at three by two also permits area twenty-four: A=(0,0,3,2), B=(4,1,2,3), C=(0,2,2,2), D=(3,0,3,1), E=(2,2,2,2). Hence this example establishes neither a benefit over the best fixed-shape solution nor a necessary temporary worsening on every improvement path.

modules.pseudo:
choose shape (w,h)
require w*h == 6 and 0.5 <= w/h <= 2
repack neighboring blocks
require completeness, containment, non_overlap
compare bounding_box_area with baseline

pitfall.zh: 变窄不等于占地变少。面积固定时，宽度减少必须由高度增加补回来；冲突可能从右边转移到上边。
pitfall.en: Narrower does not mean less area. At fixed area, reduced width requires greater height. A collision can move from the side to the top.

text.zh: A 从 3×2 改成 2×3，面积如何变化？
text.en: A changes from 3×2 to 2×3. Its area…

explain.zh: 两种尺寸乘积都为 6。
explain.en: Both products equal 6.

text.zh: A 变成 2×3，其他模块不动，撞到谁？
text.en: A becomes 2×3; others stay still. It collides with…

explain.zh: D 占据 y=2 到 3 的一条带。
explain.en: D occupies the strip from y=2 to 3.

text.zh: 1×6 面积也是 6，为什么不允许？
text.en: 1×6 also has area 6. Why is it disallowed?

explain.zh: 1/6 小于宽高比下界 0.5。
explain.en: 1/6 is below the lower aspect bound of 0.5.

text.zh: 外框 10×8，五块面积和 23。死区和外框密度分别是多少？
text.en: Outline 10×8, block area 23. What are deadspace and outline density?

text.zh: E 在 x=9、宽 2，其余模块都在框内且互不重叠。这个布局合法吗？
text.en: E starts at x=9 and is 2 wide; all other checks pass. Is the layout legal?

explain.zh: 9+2=11>10；合法性要求每个模块都在框内，且互不重叠。
explain.en: 9+2=11>10. Legality requires both containment and non-overlap.

text.en: A=(0,0,2,3), D=(0,2,3,1). What is their overlap area?

explain.zh: 共同横向区间0…2，宽2；纵向2…3，高1，所以为2。0误把内部交叠当贴边，6是A的总面积。
explain.en: Shared width is 2 and height is 1, giving 2. Zero confuses overlap with contact; 6 is A’s full area.

text.zh: A变为2×3后，只把D移到(2,2)，为什么仍失败？
text.en: After A becomes 2×3, why does moving D only to (2,2) still fail?

options.en: Only contact; the checker is wrong

explain.zh: B/D共享x=3…5、y=2…3，正面积为2。A面积仍6，D的右边缘5未越界。
explain.en: B and D share x=3…5 and y=2…3, area 2. A still has area 6; D’s right edge 5 is inside the outline.

text.zh: D移到(2,3)后合法，包围盒变为36。应怎样评价？
text.en: D at (2,3) restores legality but gives box area 36. How should it be judged?

options.zh: 修复成功，但面积目标变差

options.en: Any box above area 23 is illegal

explain.zh: 合法性回答能否这样摆；36>27说明包围盒目标变差。固定外框密度不变，不能证明最优。
explain.en: Legality asks whether placement is allowed. Since 36>27, the box objective worsened. Fixed-outline density does not prove optimality.

text.zh: 从包围盒27压到24，哪个密度提高？
text.en: Compacting the box from 27 to 24 increases which density?

explain.zh: 23/80不变；23/27提高到23/24。分母决定了比例回答的问题。
explain.en: 23/80 stays fixed, while 23/27 increases to 23/24. The denominator determines what the ratio measures.

text.zh: 单独一块面积8、比例范围0.5≤w/h≤2，哪些整数形状允许？
text.en: For a separate area-8 block with 0.5≤w/h≤2, which integer shapes are allowed?

explain.zh: 比例0.5和2都在包含端点的范围内；1/8和8超界。3×3也不行，因为面积为9。
explain.en: Ratios 0.5 and 2 are included endpoints. Ratios 1/8 and 8 fail. A 3×3 shape also fails because its area is 9.

definition.zh: 面积给定，尺寸可在约束内选择的规划模型。
definition.en: A planning model with specified area and constrained shape choices.

definition.zh: 尺寸由已有实现规定的模块。
definition.en: A block whose dimensions come from an existing implementation.

definition.zh: 宽除以高，本例范围含端点0.5与2。
definition.en: Width divided by height; this example includes limits 0.5 and 2.

definition.zh: 横向、纵向的共同长度都大于零。
definition.en: Both horizontal and vertical shared lengths are positive.
The 10×8 boundary that must contain the blocks.

definition.zh: 刚好围住当前全部模块的最小轴对齐矩形。
definition.en: The smallest axis-aligned rectangle enclosing the current blocks.

definition.zh: 同时满足全部规定约束的布局。
definition.en: A placement satisfying every stated constraint.

definition.zh: 模块面积和除以固定外框面积。
definition.en: Total block area divided by fixed outline area.

definition.zh: 合法布局的模块面积和除以包围盒面积。
definition.en: Total block area divided by box area for a legal placement.

definition.zh: 给出坐标并通过检查的一份具体可行布局。
definition.en: A concrete placement with coordinates verified by the checker.

author.zh: 原提交者（压缩包未署名）
author.en: Original contributor (archive has no author credit)

glossary: A rectangle placed as one unit.
完整、在边界内、无内部重叠，并符合模块形状规则。
包住所有模块的最小轴对齐矩形。
The smallest axis-aligned rectangle enclosing the blocks.
合法布局中：外框面积减模块面积和。
For a legal layout: outline area minus total block area.
模块面积和 / 外框面积。
模块面积和 / 包围盒面积。
已经摆放模块在各横坐标处的最高顶部。
The highest occupied top at each horizontal position.
操作数在前、组合运算符在后。
两个完整排列共同确定成对相对关系。
Two permutations encoding pairwise relative relationships.
汇总所有前驱给出的坐标下界。
Combines all predecessor lower bounds on a coordinate.
控制退火接受变差候选的倾向。
Controls tolerance of uphill annealing proposals.
本模型中面积固定、形状在界限内变化的模块。
A block with fixed area and bounded variable shape.
宽 / 高，不是高 / 宽。
